title: Grateful Dead Live at Meadowlands Arena on 1985-11-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 16-bit/44.1KHz) > cdwav (edits)
source: Nakamichi CM-300 x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell XLII-S 90)  Recorded from Taper Section 5, Row O, Seat 14

ai_review.summary: Audience‑heavy recording captures a one‑of‑a‑kind show with the standout first‑set closer “Bucket”.
ai_review.review: Reviewers describe this as a unique concert where the first‑set closer “Bucket” shines, and the overall setlist is praised. The recording is noted as very audience‑heavy, making it less pristine but still enjoyable for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Two positive 4‑star reviews highlight a great performance and standout song; one 3‑star review notes an OK show and audience‑heavy recording, leading to an overall solid rating with moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very audience‑heavy recording; ambient crowd noise is prominent, but the audio remains listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a one‑of‑a‑kind show with a strong first set closer and a setlist that “speaks for itself,” though overall impression is modestly positive.
